title: Towards an Autonomous AI Steward for Large-Scale Physics Experiments: Integrating Causal Diagnostics, RAG, and Conformal Prediction
title_zh: 迈向大规模物理实验的自主 AI 管家：融合因果诊断、RAG 与保形预测

paragraphs.en: 混合多智能体系统融合因果诊断、RAG与保形预测，为粒子物理实验提供自主运营管家。 Long-term particle physics experiments face critical operational challenges: monitoring non-stationary machine data streams and preserving tacit expert knowledge. We present the "Helmholtz Co-Pilot," a hybrid Multi-Agent System (MAS) acting as an autonomous experiment steward. The system can be triggered interactively by human operators or autonomously by an asynchronous causal diagnostics engine that runs independently of the MAS reasoning core. Continuously monitoring live hardware streams such as data acquisition and slow control, this engine performs dynamic causal discovery to trace cascading alarms back to their root causes and applies adaptive model selection to keep forecasts reliable across shifting machine states; upon detecting an anomaly, it hands a structured diagnostic report to the MAS. The reasoning layer itself relies on a high-throughput C++ core and a Python edge architecture orchestrating a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of specialized ReAct workers. It integrates a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backbone for institutional memory and leverages conformal prediction to bound its evidence-based recommendations with mathematical coverage guarantees. This extended abstract outlines the architecture, the integration of software-enforced Human-in-the-Loop (HitL) guardrails, and ongoing shadow-testing within the KATRIN experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 混合多智能体系统融合因果诊断、RAG与保形预测，为粒子物理实验提供自主运营管家。长期运行的粒子物理实验面临关键运营挑战：监测非平稳的机器数据流并保留隐性专家知识。 我们提出「Helmholtz Co-Pilot」，一个作为自主实验管家的混合多智能体系统（MAS）。 该系统既可由人类操作员交互式触发，也可由一个异步因果诊断引擎自主触发，该引擎独立于MAS推理核心运行。 该引擎持续监测数据采集与慢控制等实时硬件数据流，执行动态因果发现以将级联告警追溯到根本原因，并应用自适应模型选择以保证预测在机器状态变化中保持可靠；一旦检测到异常，它便向MAS提交一份结构化诊断报告。 推理层本身依赖一个高吞吐量C++核心和一个Python边缘架构，编排由专职ReAct工作节点组成的有向无环图（DAG）。 它集成了用于机构记忆的检索增强生成（RAG）骨干，并利用保形预测为其基于证据的建议提供具有数学覆盖保证的界限。 本扩展摘要概述了该架构、软件强制的人类在环（HitL）防护机制的集成，以及在KATRIN实验中正在进行的影子测试。
